En Python

[Video tutorial](https://youtu.be/znQnb5hZ2ls?si=wN8fNpFem0jWAoKT)


```{python}
## ! pip install pygwalker

import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import pygwalker as pyg

diamonds = sns.load_dataset(
  "diamonds", cache=True, data_home=None
  )


pyg.walk(diamonds)




```
